title: Piedmont Piano Company

services.name: Rental
services.desc: Monthly rentals require a 3 month minimum. All rental charges may be applied towards purchase as follows: May be applied towards the purchase of ANY instrument in our sale inventory (includes all new and pre-owned pianos and all new and pre-owned digital pianos) of equal or greater value to rented instrument. Please contact the store for details on delivery charges. Charges will vary depending upon distance and number of stairs. Yamaha Clavinova digital pianos may be moved by the renter, in which case, there is no delivery charge. Please contact the store for details on delivery charges. For information about renting a piano for an event on a short term basis, please visit our event rental

services.name: Music Lessons
services.desc: Since 1984, Piedmont Piano Company has been the home for high quality music instruction to the children, teens, and adults of our community. There are a number of instructors who offer private lessons at The Studios to students of every level and ambition, from the novice to the advanced. Our resident teachers offer professional-level music education in a pleasant and comfortable environment. If you would like assistance in connecting with the right teacher for your needs, please email, call, or fill out our Lesson Inquiry Google Form. blurb: With decades of musical collaboration between them, pianist Alan Broadbent and bassist Harvie S share a rare and intuitive connection that brings their performances to life. They recently finished a recording to be released in January 2027 on Savant Records, with Billy Mintz on drums, featuring four tunes with string quartet arranged by Alan.
